additional_findings: FACT. The planned price refill would put most F04 equity rows into REPAIR_REQUIRED. EXEC.md ~l.7999 item F3 plans to refill 2026-09-17/18 prices with price_update.py --mode manual and says 'Feature 04 ikut dihitung ulang lewat jalur normal'. In code it cannot be recalculated that way. Each inserted row enqueues with dirty date 2026-09-17, and enqueue deletes every checkpoint on or after that date. The worker then needs a checkpoint at 2026-09-16 and a suffix of at most 5 rows. Live checkpoints for current tickers are 2026-10-15..10-27 (v24_sched.out), and the suffix would be about 28 rows. So about 840 equity tickers would end REPAIR_REQUIRED. Repair is manual: backfill.py with --tickers (10 at a time) or with --all-source-tickers (aborts at IHSG), then bootstrap_states (aborts at IHSG unless run per --ticker). This must be sequenced before any screener reads F04.

FACT. Stock-vs-IHSG joins on F04 are misaligned. IHSG (_INDEX) has 2 dates that no equity row has (2026-09-17, 2026-09-18). A rebased 'stock vs IHSG' chart or an 'RS vs IHSG over N sessions' metric that joins F04 equity to F04_INDEX by date or by bar offset will be off by 2 sessions across that span. Evidence: v21_ihsg_dates.out.

FACT. Corporate-action breaks in live stored prices already distort F04: PBSA and FORU (see the row correction for F04-23). Any screener built on F04 or on stored prices would list them as 'RSI < 30', 'close far below MA' or 'below lower band'. No documented handling exists: grep of ERRORS_AND_SOLUTIONS, PLAN and FUTURE_PLAN finds no PBSA, FORU or split re-adjustment entry. PROPOSED: run a split/rights detector against stockbit_corporate_action (it carries STOCK_SPLIT factors and RIGHT_ISSUE) and exclude or flag affected tickers until their history is re-ingested; re-ingesting itself triggers REPAIR_REQUIRED per ticker.

FACT. F04 stores only `close` among the OHLCV fields: no open, high, low or volume. The prototype metrics hi52, lo52, breakout, volspike, MACD bullish divergence (needs lows), supertrend, ichimoku and stochastic therefore need the price table or on-the-fly calculation whatever F04 holds. Evidence: engine.py COLUMNS; prototype 9c79bf9c lines 795-828.

FACT. F04 serves few of the prototype's technical presets. The prototype's price_ma and ma_cross default to SMA, and its presets need SMA 10, 20, 50, 150 and 200 (lines 1092-1100). F04 holds only sma_20 and sma_50, and its ema_200 is not an SMA 200. Not servable from F04: Minervini, Oversold in Uptrend (SMA200), Golden Cross (SMA 50/200), Rebound (SMA10 + volume), 52W Breakout, Supertrend Flip, Ichimoku. Fully servable: only Bollinger Squeeze Breakout (bandwidth over 120 sessions + upper-band cross). Servable legs: MA20/MA50 in the bandarmology presets, ADX >= 20. The +DI/-DI operators ('plus', 'dixa') are not servable because F04 has no DI. The prototype also has its own indicator engine (xRSI, xATR at about lines 892-943); whether it equals TS F or TA-Lib is UNKNOWN here and belongs to the html_model area.

FACT. Scan cost for the latest-date screener path comes from physical layout, not from bloat. Rows are clustered by ticker, so one date's 828 rows sit on 843 heap pages, about one row per page (v09_plans.out). VACUUM FULL or pg_repack would not change that; only CLUSTER by date or a narrow latest-snapshot table would. INFERENCE: bloat matters only for multi-day windows. shared_buffers is 128 MB against a 2.5 GB heap (v30_settings.out), so multi-day screens depend on the OS cache.

FACT. The universe is static: IDX_Stock_Universe holds 845 rows (844 stocks + IHSG), all with prices. The newest first price row is RANS on 2026-07-10, followed by PRDL, BACH, EMMI, JECX and JELI in 2026-07 (v29_listings.out). INFERENCE: no new IDX listings have been added since July. A new ticker would need the manual init used for IHSG on 2026-10-23 (ihsg_price_release_job.py initialize_feature04: backfill.process_ticker + bootstrap_states --ticker --require-stored-match); no automatic path exists.

FACT. F04 histories never reset mid-history today: equity prices have 0 NULL volumes, 0 invalid OHLC and 0 negatives (40 zero-volume bars). So F04's reset rule (invalid OHLCV) and the TS def() segment rule (only the needed fields finite) do not diverge on current data, though they could diverge on future NULL-volume rows. Evidence: v26_invalid.out.

FACT. bootstrap_states.py --dry-run is not side-effect free in one sense: it still raises at IHSG. backfill.py's dry-run computes IHSG without error. A full checkpoint re-bootstrap after any version bump therefore needs a per-ticker loop, or a code fix that excludes is_universe_index().
